text: MCP tool discovery uses tools/list. The client invokes a named tool through tools/call with validated arguments.
MCP stdio transport exchanges newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages. Application logs go to stderr rather than stdout.
Python ast parses source into syntax trees. FunctionDef and AsyncFunctionDef expose function names and source line positions.
Static Python call analysis cannot always resolve dynamic dispatch or infer runtime types. A call spelling is not a proven runtime target.
GitHub pull requests support code review. A small bug fix should include a regression test and a clear explanation of changed behavior.
Retrieval augmented generation retrieves supporting documents before a language model generates an answer. Context should cite the retrieved source.
Recall measures the fraction of relevant documents retrieved. Reciprocal rank is one divided by the rank of the first relevant result.
BM25 is a lexical retrieval method using term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length normalization.
A context budget limits source material sent to a model. Select useful excerpts and retain source identifiers. Character counts differ from tokenizer token counts.
Local LLM inference runs a language model on local hardware. Model size, quantization and context length affect memory use and response latency.
Continuous integration runs automated tests on pushes and pull requests. A failing unit test should prevent an unverified change from merging.
Wireshark helps inspect network packets. Network security experiments should use traffic and systems for which testing is permitted.
